property_summary: For every caller and calldata, when the owner calls Command(...) the call is executed (call returns normally) because the reference requires msg.sender == Owner; the mutant inverts the check and thus can block/alter behavior for owner calls (owner calls to Command will be rejected by mutant for some inputs).
change_summary: Invert the owner check so the function is callable only by non-owners (require msg.sender != Owner), changing who can execute the call.
